title: The Mouth
text: The ground opens slowly like a mouth, lips of rock parting with a sound like a sigh. It breathes. Warm, wet air rolls out of it, smelling of meat. The way goes past its lip, which is very wide. You can see teeth.

options.label: Run past the lip while it breathes out, praying it does not breathe in.

outcomes.text: You race past with its hot breath on your necks. Every heart is still pounding when the next fight comes.
It snaps shut, and the teeth close on legs.

options.label: Throw something in to feed it, hoping a full mouth is a kind one.

outcomes.text: It closes slowly, satisfied, and the way beyond grows shorter. Somewhere below, it chews.

options.label: The wisest leans over the teeth and looks down to find where it leads.

outcomes.text: Down past the teeth lies the way out.
Down there is nothing at all, and the nothing looks back.
